tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures support a gradient-dependent siphon coupled to a memory state, but a close fit to five endpoints would not establish reliable forecasts. The trajectory batch adds relevant observations to separate coupling strength from the fast timescale before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter siphon-memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five endpoint observations for five parameters leave no residual degrees of freedom. The narrow horizon range makes it difficult to distinguish the fast memory timescale from coupling strength.

considered_alternatives.option: Uncoupled Kelvin–Voigt creep or damped harmonic oscillator
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Neither model uses the observed initial pool and memory states or represents the gradient-dependent sink.
The auxiliary measurement does not distinguish the coupled transient parameters.
